neighbours.label: the capital letter I as a letter or abbreviation (I/O, I-beam, re.I), not the pronoun and not a Roman numeral
fire: Disk I/O slowed down badly once the backup job started.
The steel frame uses a heavy I-beam across the whole span.
The teacher wrote a large letter I at the top of the page.
An I-shaped bracket holds the shelf against the wall.
The serial port handles I/O for the older printers in the lab.
Students traced the printed letter I with a blue crayon.
quiet: Last week I noticed that the backup job was slowing down.
When I saw the steel frame I knew the span would hold.
The teacher said that I should write my name at the top.
A U-shaped bracket holds the shelf against the wall.
The serial port was fine, and I fixed the older printers.
After Charles I died, the students left the old town.

notes: Pronoun I and regnal or war numerals stay near zero in probes; ordinary letter words fire nothing. Same token as the pronoun, so this is a context-sensitive token label.
